fusions.name: Creeper's Clasp
fusions.desc: Throws a grasping tendril that closes on the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Uprooting Wrench
fusions.desc: Grips one enemy at or below 25% health and wrenches it up by the roots, dealing 26 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Green Thumb
fusions.desc: Tends your own wounds, restoring 18 health to you with a 10% chance to heal critically.

fusions.name: Thornwood Haft
fusions.desc: Grows a briar weapon into your grip. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
